name: robosuite
description: robosuite is a simulation framework for robot learning powered by the MuJoCo physics engine. It offers a modular design for creating robotic tasks as well as a suite of benchmark environments for reproducible research. This paper discusses the key system modules and the benchmark environments of our new release robosuite v1.5.
reputation: Well-regarded in the robot-learning community as a flexible MuJoCo-based simulation suite with a set of reproducible manipulation benchmarks used by many research groups.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark. Common caveats include simulation-to-reality (sim2real) gap, dependence on MuJoCo physics settings and license, and sensitivity to environment/seeding choices that can affect reproducibility and reported scores.
